About.title: LumiqStudio by Arpha
About.intro: Smart storytelling from a smart home brand with 15+ years of building technology that brings families closer.
About.p1: LumiqStudio is the storytelling and learning division of Arpha — a smart home brand with over 15 years of experience creating technology that brings safety, convenience, and connection into everyday life.
About.p2: After building products for homes around the world, we began asking a bigger question:
About.quote1: What if technology could help families grow closer — not further apart?
About.whyP1: We believe screens should do more than entertain. They should inspire curiosity, creativity, communication, and meaningful moments between parents and children. That's why we created Lumiq — an AI-powered storytelling experience where kids don't just watch stories, they shape them.
About.whyP2: From classic fairy tales to choose-your-own adventures with dozens of endings, Lumiq transforms passive screen time into active imagination. Children can read, speak with AI, create characters, make decisions, and even turn their own ideas into real storybooks.
About.parentsP: At the same time, parents stay in control through a safe and thoughtfully designed Parent Center — built to support healthy digital habits, age-appropriate experiences, and family trust.
About.visionTitle: A natural extension of the smart home vision
About.visionP: For us, LumiqStudio is a natural extension of the smart home vision: not just smarter homes, but smarter growing together.
About.quote2: Because the future of technology shouldn't only connect devices — it should connect families.

childSafety.title: Child Safety
childSafety.intro: Our commitment to the safety and wellbeing of every child using Lumiq.
childSafety.p1: Lumiq is designed from the ground up for children. Safety is not an afterthought — it is the foundation of every feature we ship.
childSafety.p2: We never show advertising to children and we do not sell or share child data with third parties.
childSafety.p3: Every child profile is managed through a PIN-protected Parent Center. Parents control content access, screen time, and purchases.
childSafety.p4: All stories and features are reviewed and rated for age appropriateness. Age filters ensure children only see content suitable for them.
childSafety.p5: We comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and similar regulations worldwide.
childSafety.p6: If you have a concern about child safety on our platform, please contact safety@lumiqstudio.com immediately.

Story.titleBefore: A studio shaped by the question:
Story.titleEm: how do we enhance the things we use?
Story.heroAlt: Three generations of a family reading and creating a story together with Lumiq devices nearby
Story.heroVideoPlay: Play the Lumiq Studio brand film
Story.origin1: Lumiq Studio began with a small group of designers, engineers and parents who kept asking the same question — what is technology actually for, when the noise dies down?
Story.origin2: We were tired of products that demanded attention and gave very little back. We wanted to make objects that earned a place in the home: quiet, warm, considered. The kind of things that get shared rather than replaced.
Story.origin3: We design experiences at the intersection of artificial intelligence, storytelling and craft. Our work spans hardware, software and printed objects — connected by a single intention: to give families and creators tools that lift their imagination instead of crowding it.
Story.p1Body: No feeds, no streaks, no noise. Every Lumiq object is designed to end in a story, not a scroll.
Story.p2Body: We build for the room, not the individual screen — moments that parents, children and grandparents share.
Story.p3Body: AI helps narrate, illustrate and personalise — always with the person, never instead of them.
Story.p4Body: Objects that earn a place in the home: warm, considered, and made to be kept rather than replaced.
Story.quote: The future of technology should not only connect devices — it should connect families.
Story.timelineTitle: A short history of a long idea.
Story.m1Body: Fifteen years of smart-home craft — safety, convenience and connection for families worldwide.
Story.m2Body: What if technology could help families grow closer, not further apart? Lumiq Studio begins as a sketch.
Story.m3Body: Designers, engineers and parents gather around one table — and one intention.
Story.m4Body: Lumiq Tablet, Lumiq Print and Lumiq Ola — three objects that began one quiet universe.
Story.futureTitle: An ecosystem, not a product line.
Story.future1: We're building toward a world where AI feels less like a tool and more like a thoughtful companion — one that helps people read, write, dream and design together.
Story.future2: Every device, every page, every interface we ship is a step toward that quieter, more imaginative tomorrow.

Tablet.spotlightsBody: Lumiq turns reading into a personal journey through classic tales, original adventures, sound, pictures, face personalization, printable books, and interactive choices.

Tablet.spot1Body: Classic stories, personalized roles, and branching paths create more ways to explore.
Tablet.spot2Alt: A child's hand touching a magical tablet screen
Tablet.spot2Body: Interactive stories can connect with Lumiq Ola to bring characters and conversations into the room.
Tablet.spot3Alt: A protective shield around a tablet with parental controls
Tablet.spot3Body: Parental controls, blue-light filtering, and screen-time management help children focus on the adventure.
Tablet.howTitle: Four steps to bring stories into your child's room.
Tablet.howBody: Lumiq turns reading into a journey children can choose, shape, and see — helping them think with AI while preserving their own imagination.
Tablet.step1Body: Open a story where text, illustration, narration, and music arrive together from the first page.
Tablet.step2Body: Illustrations respond as children read, opening new ways to explore each scene.
Tablet.step3Body: Add up to three familiar faces and a recorded voice to make the story feel personal.
Tablet.step4Body: Place the tablet beside Lumiq Ola to explore character conversations and questions about the story.
Tablet.growsTitle: A storyworld that grows up with them.
Tablet.growsBody: From the first lullaby to a self-written novel, Lumiq evolves through three chapters of childhood — with your child at the heart of the story.
Tablet.age1Alt: A parent and toddler reading a glowing storybook
Tablet.age1Body: Lullabies and bedtime tales can use a familiar parent voice while ImagiMe places the child inside the picture book.
Tablet.age1Item1: Beautifully illustrated classics and nursery rhymes
Tablet.age1Item3: ImagiMe makes the child the story hero
Tablet.age2Alt: A child reaching toward a holographic fairy companion
Tablet.age2Body: Stories extend beyond the screen as children talk with fairy-tale friends through Lumiq Ola.
Tablet.age2Item1: Talk and play with characters through Lumiq Ola
Tablet.age2Item2: Explore a Lumiq Print hardcover keepsake
Tablet.age2Item4: Reward charts that celebrate active reading
Tablet.age3Alt: A pre-teen creating a fantasy story with a tablet
Tablet.age3Body: Branching choices open many possible endings and let children explore how each decision changes the story.
Tablet.age3Item1: Chaptered StoryQuest adventures with many endings
Tablet.age3Item4: Stories that can continue over time
Tablet.powersTitle: Five real-world strengths hidden inside every story.
Tablet.powersBody: Every Lumiq adventure supports creativity, confidence, curiosity, and communication while children play.
Tablet.power1Body: Children keep turning pages because they want to discover what happens next.
Tablet.power2Body: Every choice shapes the story and helps children explore outcomes and trust their judgment.
Tablet.power3Body: Ideas become visible stories children can see and share.
Tablet.power4Body: Playful conversations help children ask questions, express ideas, and communicate clearly.
Tablet.power5Body: A small spark becomes a complete story children can proudly finish and share.
Tablet.parentsTitle: A Parent Center built for trust — protected by your PIN
Tablet.parentsBody: Profiles, purchases, content, and screen-time settings live in the Parent Center behind a 6-digit PIN. Children can read and play while only a parent can change limits or spend points.
Tablet.earnDetail: Original Story +10 · AI Story +30 · Treasure Adventure +50
Tablet.purchasePin: Every purchase and redemption requires your Parent PIN
Tablet.parent1Body: Manage up to three child profiles, including names, avatars, family characters, and voice-over.
Tablet.parent2Body: Set daily screen-time and age filters behind the Parent PIN.
Tablet.parent3Body: Review weekly reading time, finished books, and recently explored titles.
Tablet.parent4Body: Children earn points and badges for finishing stories, encouraging more reading and less scrolling.
Tablet.parent5Body: Use points or money for Lumiq add-ons and partner coupons. Every checkout requires the Parent PIN.
